raw_segments.text: And by that way, when the herds innumerable of bellwethers and flushed yews, and shearling
rams and lambs, and stubble geese and medium steers, and roaring mares, and poled calves
and longwalls and store sheep and cuffs, prime springers and culls and soapigs and bacon
hogs, and the various different varieties of highly distinguished swine and angus heifers,
and poly-bullocks of immaculate pedigree, together with prime-premiated milch cows and
thieves. And there is ever heard a trampling, cackling, roaring, lowing, bleeding, bellowing,
rumbling, grunting, champing, chewing of sheep and pigs and heavy-hooved kind from pasturelands
of lusk and rush and carrickmines, and from the streamy veils of tamand, from the M. Gilakuttis
reeks the inaccessible and lordly Shannon the unfathomable, and from the gentle declivities
of the place of the race of Khire. Their udders distended with superabundance of milk and
butts of butter and rennets of cheese and farmers, furkins and targets of lamb and crannocks
of corn and oblong eggs in great hundreds. Various in size, the agate with this done.
